A one-shot shield on a player's next roll: one die more, and the shield's controller (not the roller) chooses the result to ignore, asked inside the roll (r6402_change path)
The type and amount of mana spent on an activation kept on the source, a mana ability adding that noted mana, and a spend restriction to the last card exiled with it (no fixture)
Creating a card from a fixed list of names outside the game (conjure by Oracle name) with a once-per-name memory, and a cast permission for the copy
Secret votes for up to one creature (Effect::Vote over objects with secrecy and abstention) with destroy of each tied for most votes and a draw for each player when none got votes

Activated abilities of a spell on the stack that any player may activate (CR 113.6) and a change of target as their effect

An as-enters replacement exiling X chosen creature cards from the graveyard, else to the graveyard instead, with a counter kind chosen per exiled card
A land type granted while a counter remains and a delayed trigger for the rest of the game that removes the counters put by this artifact (objects linked across zones)
Condition: the chosen color is the most common color among nontoken permanents a chosen player controls and not tied
Changing the target of a spell with a single target when that target is you to another player (CR 115.7a) with X twice the spell's mana value
Abilities granted to creatures while a spell is on the stack, preventing damage from that spell
Contraptions: a ReplaceWhen for a Rigger assembling a Contraption (no Contraption deck in the engine)
